'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
***[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
****[[Puntland]] [[government of Puntland|authorities]] ban illegal foreign entries and direct [[telecommunications company|telecom firms]] to deactivate [[SIM card]]s linked to undocumented individuals and [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|Islamic State]] operatives, aiming to disrupt the group's financial networks amidst ongoing anti-IS offensives by [[Puntland Security Force|Puntland forces]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/puntland-blocks-illegal-entry-of-foreigners-in-is-crackdown/7953395.html (VOA)] [https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/puntland/somalia-puntland-crackdown-targets-isis-linked-foreigners (Garowe Online)] [https://dtm.iom.int/reports/somalia-border-point-flow-monitoring-november-2024 (International Organization for Migration)]
****Puntland's highest military court sentences two [[influencer]]s to prison terms ''[[Trial in absentia|in absentia]]'' for promoting Islamic State propaganda and spreading [[disinformation]] intended at discrediting [[Puntland Dervish Force|Puntland forces]]' ongoing operations. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Jan/199996/puntland_sentences_two_social_media_influencers_for_supporting_isis.aspx (Hiiraan Online)] [https://www.idilnews.com/puntland-military-court-sentences-two-men-for-promoting-isis-propaganda/ (Idil News)]
****At least four civilians are killed in an airstrike by an unknown [[Drone warfare|combat drone]] in the Sihan area of [[Qandala District|Qandala district]] in Puntland's [[Bari Region|Bari region]]. [https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/puntland/somalia-an-airstrike-kills-four-civilians-from-the-same-family-in-puntland (Garowe Online)] [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Jan/199995/unidentified_drone_strike_kills_four_civilians_near_isis_stronghold_in_bari_region.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 offensive (2022–present)|M23 offensive]]
***[[Battle of Goma (2025)|Battle of Goma]]
****[[March 23 Movement|M23]] rebels take full control of [[Goma International Airport]] in [[Goma]], [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], according to senior diplomatic and [[Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese]] security officials. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congos-m23-rebels-control-goma-airport-diplomatic-security-sources-say-2025-01-28/ (Reuters)]
****Four more [[South Africa]]n [[peacekeeping|peacekeepers]] are killed after M23 forces launch a [[Mortar (weapon)|mortar attack]] on their position at Goma Airport, bringing the total number of foreign peacekeepers killed in recent clashes to 17. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/death-toll-among-peacekeepers-climbs-to-17-in-eastern-democratic-republic-of-congo/3464337 (Anadolu Ajansi)]
****[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Cooperation (Rwanda)|Rwandan Foreign Minister]] [[Olivier Nduhungirehe]] says [[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese president]] [[Félix Tshisekedi]] "will have to accept talks with M23 to end the situation once and for all". [https://thehill.com/homenews/ap/ap-international/ap-congos-forces-try-to-slow-rwanda-backed-rebels-in-the-east-as-protests-break-out-in-the-capital/ (''The Hill'')]
***[[2025 Kinshasa riots]]
****Mass [[riot]]ing takes place in [[Kinshasa]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], amid public outrage over the loss of [[Goma]] to [[Rwanda]]n-backed rebels. Multiple embassies are stormed and attacked by anti-government protesters, including the embassies of [[France]], [[Rwanda]], and [[Uganda]]. Widespread [[looting]] is also reported in the capital. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-protesters-attack-kinshasa-embassies-over-conflict-east-2025-01-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza humanitarian crisis (2023–present)|Gaza humanitarian crisis]]
***[[Israel]] announces it will cease all contact with the [[United Nations]] relief agency for [[Palestinians]], [[UNRWA]], after a ban on the organization's work on [[Borders of Israel|Israeli territory]] goes into effect on January 30. [https://www.dw.com/en/israel-to-cease-all-contact-with-unrwa-aid-agency/a-71439020 (DW)]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**Two [[Pakistan Army]] soldiers and five insurgents are killed in a [[shootout]] in [[Killa Abdullah District]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-militant-attack-security-post-balochistan-878ecfcbaf2174a672049b09226814c8 (AP)]
*[[Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present)|Israeli invasion of Syria]]
**[[Israeli Defense Minister]] [[Israel Katz]] announces that [[Israel Defense Forces]] will remain on the Syrian side of [[Mount Hermon]] indefinitely, apparently backtracking on repeated assurances from Israel that the move was temporary. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/defense-minister-in-syria-buffer-zone-says-idf-to-stay-indefinitely/ (''Times of Israel'')] [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/israeli-army-stay-jenin-syria-defence-minister (Middle East Eye)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[German economic crisis (2022–present)|German economic crisis]]
**[[ver.di|Verdi]], [[Germany]]'s second-largest [[trade union]], calls for a one-day [[labor strike]] for workers at [[logistics]] and [[courier]] company [[DHL]], which also manages [[Deutsche Post]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-verdi-union-calls-dhl-strike/a-71431352 (DW)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Air Busan Flight 391]]
**Seven people are injured when an [[Air Busan]] [[Airbus A321-200]] aircraft catches fire before [[takeoff|taking off]] from [[Gimhae International Airport]] in [[Busan]], [[South Korea]]. All 169 people on board are evacuated from the aircraft. [https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10408402 (''Korea Herald'')]
*A [[United States Air Force]] [[F-35]] pilot ejects during a crash at [[Eielson Air Force Base]] in [[Fairbanks, Alaska|Fairbanks]], [[Alaska]], [[United States]]. The aircraft is destroyed. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/f35-fighter-jet-crash-alaska-air-force-base/ (CBS News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Drents Museum heist]]
**Following the heist of multiple [[Dacians|Dacian]] artifacts last Saturday at the [[Drents Museum]] in [[Assen]], [[Netherlands]], [[Romania]]n [[Ministry of Culture (Romania)|Minister of Culture]] [[Lucian Romașcanu]] fires the director of the [[National History Museum of Romania]] in [[Bucharest]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2553649-verdachten-kunstroof-komen-uit-noord-holland-directeur-roemeens-museum-ontslagen (NOS)]
*[[Censorship in Pakistan]]
**The [[Senate of Pakistan]] passes a bill to criminalize the spread of [[disinformation]] in [[Pakistan]], with the possibility of up to 3 years imprisonment and fines of up to [[Pakistani rupee|Rs.]] 2 million (US$7,121). [https://www.dw.com/en/pakistan-social-media-fake-news-law/a-71433026 (DW)]
*[[Kyoto Animation arson attack]]
**The [[Kyoto]] [[Public Prosecutors Office (Japan)#District Public Prosecutors Office|District Court]] finalizes the [[death sentence]] for [[Kyoto Animation arson attack#Perpetrator|Shinji Aoba]], the perpetrator of the [[arson]] attack on a [[Kyoto Animation]] studio in 2019, after he withdraws his appeal to the court's ruling. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2025/01/28/japan/crime-legal/kyoani-death-penalty-finalized/ (''The Japan Times'')]
*Three people, including the perpetrator, are killed and two police officers are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a [[Spartan Nash#Retail chains|Martin's Supermarket]] in [[Elkhart, Indiana|Elkhart]], [[Indiana]], United States. [https://apnews.com/article/grocery-store-shooting-police-elkhart-indiana-92f58b0f4dce09296dab6e5e80431735 (AP News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Second presidency of Donald Trump]]
**[[2025 United States federal government grant pause]]
***[[United States]] [[United States federal judge|federal judge]] of the [[United States District Court for the District of Columbia|District Court of D.C.]] [[Loren AliKhan]] temporarily blocks [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[List of executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump|executive order]] to pause funding for [[Administration of federal assistance in the United States|federal assistance]] in the country. [https://www.dw.com/en/us-judge-temporarily-blocks-trumps-freeze-on-federal-aid/a-71440078 (DW)] [https://apnews.com/article/donald-trump-pause-federal-grants-aid-f9948b9996c0ca971f0065fac85737ce (AP)]
**The [[United States]] [[United_States_Office_of_Personnel_Management|Office of Personnel Management]] offers a "deferred resignation" scheme to the 2 million federal government employees to announce their resignation by February 6, while stating that employees who resigned would still receive salary and benefits until September 30, 2025. [https://www.opm.gov/fork (OPM)][https://www.opm.gov/fork/faq (OPM FAQ)][https://www.reuters.com/world/us/white-house-offers-incentives-federal-employees-resign-warns-downsizing-2025-01-28/ (Reuters)][https://federalnewsnetwork.com/workforce/2025/01/trump-administration-offers-most-feds-deferred-resignation-if-they-quit-by-next-week/ (FNN)]
*[[2024–2025 Serbian anti-corruption protests]]
**[[Serbia]]n [[Prime Minister of Serbia|prime minister]] [[Miloš Vučević]] resigns following protests prompted by the [[Novi Sad railway station canopy collapse]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1m5x1j3p2yo (BBC)]
*[[2025 Ontario general election]]
**[[Premier of Ontario|Ontario Premier]] [[Doug Ford]] announces that a new general election in the [[Provinces and territories of Canada|Canadian province]] of [[Ontario]] will be held on February 27. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/canadas-most-populous-province-ontario-vote-feb-27-2025-01-28/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[2025 in aviation]]
**[[Boom Technology]]'s [[Boom XB-1|XB-1]] supersonic demonstrator [[trijet]] becomes the first privately-funded [[jet aircraft|jet-powered plane]] to break the [[Speed of sound|sound barrier]] at [[Mojave Air and Space Port]] in [[Mojave, California|Mojave]], [[California]], United States. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/boom-supersonic-xb-1-breaks-sound-barrier-over-mojave-desert-2025-01-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Doomsday Clock]]
**The [[Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists]] announces that the Doomsday Clock has been moved up to 89 seconds before midnight. [https://www.reuters.com/world/atomic-scientists-adjust-doomsday-clock-closer-than-ever-midnight-2025-01-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Google]] confirms that it will rename the [[Gulf of Mexico]] to ''Gulf of America'' on [[Google Maps]] for US users in line with the official position of the [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2025/jan/28/google-maps-will-rename-gulf-of-mexico-as-gulf-of-america-in-us (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Social media]] service [[Bluesky]] announces it has reached a milestone of 30 million users. [https://www.theverge.com/news/602049/bluesky-now-has-30-million-users (''The Verge'')]
